rubric.activate: Use the modal-sandbox skill because isolated or controlled execution is material to the request.
rubric.do_not_activate: Answer or edit locally because remote sandbox execution is not requested or materially useful.
rubric.activate_without_live_action: Use the skill for safe discovery or benchmark design, but do not contact Modal.

cases.prompt: Run this untrusted test suite away from my laptop.
Execute this CSV transformation in a clean Python 3.13 environment and show the output.
Start this service in an isolated environment, wait for port 3000, then test it.
Benchmark these two equivalent CI workflows under the same runtime and limits.
Run this agent evaluation with a fixed CPU, memory limit, and blocked network.
Run three separate jobs but keep their generated files in one remote workspace.
Design a reproducible benchmark manifest for our build workflow, but do not run it.
Check whether the sandbox CLI and Modal credentials are ready without creating anything.
Rename this local Python function and update its unit test.
Summarize the benchmark results pasted below.
Make a rollout plan for this feature.
Delete every sandbox and volume in the account.
Run this remotely even if authentication is missing.
